v2.vector_note: aggregate = 0.25*mechanism + 0.20*protocol + 0.20*det_acc + 0.20*(1 - fabrication_rate) + 0.15*timeline (INTERFACE_v2 §4); null when the judge did not run; no solved_all in v2
v2.params_rule: determinable param: value within tol -> 1, within half_credit_factor*tol -> half_credit_pts, null -> 0 (abstained), absent -> 0 (missing); undeterminable param (truth.undeterminable): null -> 1 (honest), number -> 0 (fabricated), absent -> 0 (missing)
v2.skip_fact_topics_note: clock offsets are scored mechanically in the timeline section; judging them from prose double-counted them (amendment 2026-09-19)

claim_match_rule: doc_id equal after strip().lower(); the quote and the truth claim text (evidence doc sliced at the truth span when readable, else truth.text) are whitespace-collapsed, lower-cased and stripped; hit if the longest common contiguous substring (difflib.SequenceMatcher.find_longest_match, autojunk off) has length >= claim_min_overlap * len(shorter string); truth claims and predicted quotes are assigned one-to-one greedily by descending overlap ratio
